nodes.name: Configuration
nodes.notes: Set your repo, language, webhook URL, and API key here. Override via workflow static data or external config.

nodes.name: Generate Summary
nodes.notes: Calls the Anthropic Messages API. Credential should have header name 'x-api-key' and your API key as value.

nodes.name: Deliver to Webhook
nodes.notes: Delivers the formatted summary to your configured webhook URL. Works with Discord webhooks out of the box. For Slack, adjust the payload format in the body.
